bayts.text: The blessing of Him Who in every month, and in Ṣafar, protected me, (be) upon the Effacer who effaced captivity and the (forced) journey.
Success (lies) in my being the slave of my Lord, his servant: a marvel through him the One Who frees from the throng (of men) has bestowed on me.
I am well pleased with the Master and with the best of His creatures — upon him peace — through whom I returned with triumph.
Blessing and peace, with gladness, forever, upon him through whom (is) my abiding with safety and joy.
My flight (to God), through the Chosen, already before led to me abiding and glad tidings among jinn and men.
I have raised gratitude, after an eternalised praise, to an Everlasting One Who effaced my harm, that which the decree had held.
The blessing of Him Whom I invoke, His slave through him, (be) upon him through whom He led to me clarity without turbidity.
The eloquence of the best of creation brought forth my qaṣīdas, and my being through them his slave and servant has become manifest.
I have gained a gain whose like never was, by the grace of Him with Whom my being His beloved has become renowned.
The blessing of Him Who led to me my being His intimate (be) upon him through whom He made the desert and the town good for me.
The openings of the Lord of the Throne have purified my faults, by the standing of him through whom those of Muḍar who rose took pride.
My gain in the service of the best of creation has appeared, and in every month (there is) the increase of my gain, and in Ṣafar.
